name: Cabin A: The Retreat
drawing_accuracy: diagrammatic; dimensions and openings require professional verification
summary: A single 40-foot high-cube container with continuous external insulation, a timber rainscreen and an independent screened porch. Sleeping, living, kitchenette and bathroom zones are arranged so that no room is a pass-through to another.

provenance.source: Original concept geometry. No third-party plans, models or drawings are used.
provenance.method: Parametric. All drawings, the OBJ model and the browser explorer are generated from this file by tools/build.mjs.
provenance.verification: None. Not reviewed by an architect, engineer, building official or accessibility consultant.
changes: 1.1.0: Parametric single source of truth; openings, rooms, fixtures, envelope layers, porch, ramp, trellis and roof options added; rooms reordered so the bathroom is no longer a pass-through.

module.note: Typical published dimensions for a 40-foot high cube. Measure the actual unit: internal dimensions, corrugation depth and floor build-up vary by manufacturer.

wall_layers.name: Continuous external insulation (type TBD)
wall_layers.options: wood fibre board, mineral wool or reclaimed board, chosen for moisture tolerance, fire performance and embodied carbon

wall_layers.name: Ventilated cavity / weather control (TBD)
wall_layers.options: battens over a vapour-open weather-resistive barrier; insect mesh at top and bottom

wall_layers.name: Replaceable timber rainscreen
wall_layers.options: untreated durable species or reclaimed boards, screw-fixed for replacement

envelope.interior_layers_note: 40 mm service battens and lining inside the steel; 20 mm floor finish over the container floor; 30 mm ceiling lining.
envelope.unspecified: Air, vapour, thermal bridge and fastening details are intentionally unspecified. Selective spray foam requires separate assessment.

foundation.type: Helical (screw) piles at the corner castings and mid-span: concept placeholder
foundation.note: Pile type, depth and bearing need a geotechnical investigation and structural design. Piles bear on the steel through the floor insulation, which creates thermal bridges to be detailed. Piles are not automatically appropriate near wetlands or on rock.

rooms.name: Sleeping
rooms.use: Bedroom with a double bed, wardrobe and windows to the south and west (lake side).
rooms.accessibility: About 0.9 m clear beside the bed and 1.0 m at its foot. A 1.5 m turning circle does not fit with this layout: an accessible variant needs a smaller bed, a longer room or a different arrangement.

rooms.name: Living
rooms.use: Main entry from the north path, sliding glass doors to the screened porch, bench seating and a table.
rooms.accessibility: Step-free route from the porch ramp through the sliding door (threshold to be designed). Entry door clear width target 0.86 m or more.

rooms.name: Kitchenette
rooms.use: Single counter run on the south wall with a window over the sink, refrigerator at the end of the run, open to living.
rooms.accessibility: About 1.6 m clear between the counter and the north wall. Counter height, knee space and controls to be designed for seated use.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.use: Roll-in shower along the east wall, toilet, wall-hung vanity and a high window for privacy.
rooms.accessibility: 2.27 x 2.27 m clear; a 1.5 m turning circle overlaps the curbless shower area. Grab bars, fixture clearances and controls must be checked against CSA B651 and the applicable building code.

fixtures.name: Kitchen counter with sink and induction hob

openings.name: West window (lake view, egress size to verify)
Sliding glass doors to screened porch

porches.name: Screened porch
porches.note: Deck at interior floor level for step-free access. Stands on its own piles, 20 mm clear of the rainscreen, so it can be repaired or replaced without disturbing the envelope.

ramps.note: Concept only. Landings, edge protection, handrails, surface and drainage to be designed to CSA B651 and the applicable code. Every 0.1 m of floor height adds 1.5 m of ramp at 1:15.

trellis.note: Free-standing trellis on its own footings, 350 mm from the rainscreen, so roots, moisture and maintenance stay off the envelope. Shades the west wall in summer. Native climbers only.

pv.label: PV array on a membrane roof

biosolar.label: Biosolar: extensive green roof with raised PV

roof.note: PV is shown flat; tilt, racking, snow shedding and fire-access setbacks are to be designed. A green roof is never assumed: saturated growing medium, snow, drainage, waterproofing, maintenance and fire must be engineered. Planting stays below the raised panels so it never shades them.

design_targets.note: Project targets, not code values. Verify against CSA B651 and the applicable provincial building code.

screened_porch.note: Retained for compatibility with Phase 1. The authoritative porch definition is porches[0].

design_intent: selective spray foam subject to review

material_passport.material: Weathering steel, corrugated walls and roof, steel cross-members
material_passport.condition_assessment: Required before purchase: corrosion, deformation, weld repairs, CSC plate history, prior cargo, and coatings tested for hazardous substances.
material_passport.connections: Welded original structure; new openings cut and reinforced; bolted lifting and foundation connections where feasible.
material_passport.disassembly: Module can be lifted and relocated as a unit.
material_passport.end_of_life: Reuse as a module, otherwise steel recycling.

material_passport.material: Original hardwood plywood deck on steel cross-members
material_passport.condition_assessment: Original container floors are often treated with pesticides. Test, then replace or encapsulate before occupancy.
material_passport.end_of_life: Hazardous-waste route if treatment is confirmed

material_passport.material: Wood fibre board, mineral wool or documented reclaimed board (TBD)
material_passport.condition_assessment: Reclaimed board: verify type, blowing agent, contamination and fire classification.
material_passport.connections: Mechanically fixed through battens; no adhesives on the steel
material_passport.disassembly: Unscrew battens and lift off boards
material_passport.end_of_life: Reuse; wood fibre can be composted or recovered when uncontaminated

material_passport.material: Durable timber boards on timber battens
material_passport.source: Prefer local reclaimed or certified timber
material_passport.condition_assessment: Reclaimed boards: check for nails, lead paint and rot.

material_passport.material: Triple-glazed units in timber or fibreglass frames (TBD)
material_passport.source: New or salvaged units of known performance
material_passport.condition_assessment: Salvaged units: verify seal integrity, labelled performance and safety glazing.
material_passport.connections: Installed in the insulation layer on brackets (outie)

material_passport.material: Timber frame, decking, insect screen and steel connectors
material_passport.source: Local timber; reclaimed where structurally graded
material_passport.condition_assessment: Grade reclaimed members for structural use.

material_passport.material: Crystalline silicon modules on aluminium rails
material_passport.condition_assessment: Second-life modules: flash test and insulation resistance test.
material_passport.connections: Clamped to rails; no roof penetrations through the membrane where avoidable

reviews_required.topic: Structure: cut openings, lifting points, snow, wind and seismic loads, porch and roof options
Foundations: soils, frost, pile type and depth, wetland and shoreline proximity
Envelope: air, vapour and moisture control, condensation on steel, thermal bridges
Fire: separations, cladding, spray foam (if any), PV and battery safety, wildland interface
reviews_required.reviewer: Fire protection engineer and building official

reviews_required.topic: Accessibility: ramp, thresholds, door clearances, bathroom and kitchen
reviews_required.reviewer: Accessibility consultant; CSA B651 and applicable code

reviews_required.topic: Mechanical and electrical: heating, ventilation, water, wastewater, PV
reviews_required.reviewer: Mechanical and electrical engineers; electrical safety authority

reviews_required.topic: Code and zoning compliance for the actual site
reviews_required.reviewer: Architect or qualified designer; municipal building department
